desc.en: Adds cryogenic liquid to the explosion of the rocket. Cold slows down enemies and can eventually freeze them. The explosion deals almost no damage, but the area of effect increases.
desc.zh: 往火箭弹中加入冷冻剂，使其爆炸时传播冷气，减速敌人，并最终冻住它们。这一行为导致火箭弹爆炸几乎没有伤害，但它的爆炸作用范围会提升。

desc.en: Bullets coming out of the primary weapon have a chance to electrocute.
desc.zh: 博斯科的主武器发射的子弹有几率使敌人触电。

desc.en: Increases the total amount of rockets Bosco can fire before regenerating.
desc.zh: 增加博斯科在需要重新装填前可以发射的火箭弹数量。

desc.en: One extra revive kit to bring back to action an incapacitated dwarf.
desc.zh: 额外携带一份急救套件，使独自进行任务的矮人多一次重新站起来的机会。

desc.en: One extra revive kit to bring back to action an incapacitated dwarf.
desc.zh: 额外携带一份急救套件，使独自进行任务的矮人多一次重新站起来的机会。

desc.en: It takes less time for the rockets to be ready to shoot again.
desc.zh: 减少火箭弹的充能时间。

desc.en: A significant lumens increase that can make the difference in some of the darkest caves.
desc.zh: 显著提升机载探照灯的流明，提升在黑暗洞穴的沉浸式挖矿体验。

desc.en: Improves Bosco's capabilities to mine minerals, dirt, or any kind of terrain
desc.zh: 提升博斯科挖掘矿物、泥土等地形的速度。

desc.en:
A secondary weapon that can shoot explosive rockets.
Bosco's AI is not ready to handle this kind of weaponry, use the LASER POINTER for manual activation.
desc.zh:
加装可以发射爆破火箭弹的次要武器。
博斯科的人工智能还不足以主动使用这种大威力武器，需要使用激光指示器来手动下达射击指令。

desc.en: The primary damage of the weapon is increased.
desc.zh: 博斯科的主武器伤害提升。

desc.en: Increased area of effect for the explosion of the rocket.
desc.zh: 提升火箭弹的爆炸范围。

desc.en: Higher chance for the rocket explosion to shatter armor.
desc.zh: 火箭弹的爆炸有更高几率粉碎护甲。

desc.en: There is a chance to scare enemies away from the explosion of the rockets.
desc.zh: 火箭弹的爆炸有几率将敌人吓退。

desc.en: For those who prefer it medium rare. Flames will inflict half as much damage.
desc.zh: 为那些喜欢被烤到五分熟的人设计——受到的火焰伤害减半。

desc.en: Reduces the damage taken from poison.
desc.zh: 减少毒素造成的伤害。

desc.en: Fire in the hole! Fancy Reactive Armor plating takes half the sting out of any explosions.
desc.zh: 要爆炸了！先进的反应装甲可承受任何形式的爆炸，使受到的爆炸伤害减半。

desc.en: For those prefer it medium rare. Flames will inflict half as much damage.
desc.zh: 为那些喜欢被烤到五分熟的人设计——受到的火焰伤害减半。

desc.zh: 你的护盾可抵挡更多伤害。

desc.en: Your shield can withstand even more damage.
desc.zh: 你的护盾可抵挡更多的伤害。

desc.en: Breathing poison will only be half as harmful for your organism.
desc.zh: 吸入毒气时对你造成的伤害减半。

desc.en: Fire in the hole! Fancy Reactive Armor plating takes half the sting out of any explosions.
desc.zh: 炸个痛快！先进的反应性护甲内衬能够吸收一半的爆炸伤害。

desc.en: Your shield can withstand more damage.
desc.zh: 你的护盾可抵挡更多伤害。

desc.en: Your shield can withstand even more damage.
desc.zh: 你的护盾可抵挡更多的伤害。

desc.en: Built-in shock absorbers make falling less painful.
desc.zh: 内置减震器，可减少坠落伤害。

desc.en: Built-in shock absorbers make falling less painful.
desc.zh: 内置减震器，可减少坠落伤害。

desc.en: Killing an enemy increases accuracy
desc.zh: 击杀敌人可以提高精准度

desc.en: Move faster for a short time after killing an enemy
desc.zh: 击杀敌人后获得短暂移速加成。

desc.en: Base accuracy improvement with pin-point accuracy on first shot.
desc.zh: 整体精准度提升，且武器最小扩散变为绝对精准。

desc.en: Improved Accuracy and Faster Movement whenever you kill an enemy
desc.zh: 击杀敌人后提高精准度和移动速度。

desc.en: Increased chance to stun the target on a weakpoint hit
desc.zh: 击中敌人弱点时有更大几率造成击晕。

desc.en: Base accuracy improvement with pin-point accuracy on first shot and better recoil compensation overall.
desc.zh: 武器整体精准度提升，且最小扩散变为绝对精准，后坐抑制也优化了不少。

desc.en: Killing an enemy increases accuracy
desc.zh: 击杀敌人可以提高精准度

desc.en: Move faster for a short time after killing an enemy
desc.zh: 击杀敌人后获得短暂移速加成。

desc.en: Improved Accuracy
desc.zh: 提升精准度。

desc.en: Improved Accuracy
desc.zh: 提升精准度

desc.en: Increased splash damage
desc.zh: 提升溅射伤害。

desc.en: Greater splash damage radius
desc.zh: 更大的溅射伤害范围。

desc.en: Chance to scare creatures next to a bullet impact
desc.zh: 有几率吓退子弹命中点附近的生物。

desc.en: Increased damage when at max rate of fire
desc.zh: 提升达到最大射速后的伤害。

desc.en: Take significantly less damage when at max rate of fire.
desc.zh: 在达到最大射速时显著减少受到的伤害。

desc.en: Focus faster when holding down the trigger.
desc.zh: 瞄准的速度更快。

desc.en: Improved hip-shot accuracy and stability
desc.zh: 提升腰射精准度和稳定性。

desc.en: Greater focus damage bonus
desc.zh: 更高的瞄准射击伤害加成。

desc.en: You can perform a lightning-fast reload right after killing an enemy.
desc.zh: 击杀敌人后可以立即快如闪电地换弹。

desc.en: Killing your target with a focused shot to the weakspot will send nearby creatures fleeing with terror!
desc.zh: 瞄准射击命中弱点击杀敌人会让附近生物在恐惧中逃离！

desc.en: Focused shots stagger the target
desc.zh: 瞄准射击会使造成硬直。

desc.en: More bullets faster! Fire more rounds in each burst and at a higher rate.
desc.zh: 更快射出更多的子弹！每次射击时以更高速度射出更多子弹。

desc.en: Damage bonus on last bullet if the first two hit
desc.zh: 前两发子弹击中后，第三发子弹获得伤害加成

desc.en: Shorter delay between bursts
desc.zh: 每轮射击的间隔更短。

desc.en: Stun target if all shots in a burst hit
desc.zh: 一轮射击的子弹全部命中敌人时会造成击晕。

desc.en: More bullets, faster! Fire more rounds at a higher rate in each burst.
desc.zh: 更快射出更多的子弹！每轮点射以更高速度射出更多子弹。

desc.en: The charged projectile deals damage to nearby enemies as it flies.
desc.zh: 充能发射物在飞行途中对附近敌人造成伤害。

desc.en: Any high-energy impact will destabilize the Charged Projectile causing a large area implosion. The weak field takes less energy to create and so the weapon no longer overheats after each charged shot.
desc.zh: 任何高能冲击都能使充能发射物不稳定，使其产生更大范围的内爆。弱力场需要更少的能量去创造，因此在每次充能射击后武器不再过热。

desc.en: A modified containment field causes regular shots to heat up the target proportionally to the amount of damage dealt.
desc.zh: 修改过的收容力场能使普通射击加热目标，加热量正比于造成的伤害。

desc.en: Improves the damage caused by the normal shots.
desc.zh: 提升普通射击造成的伤害。

desc.en: Greater damage radius for the charged projectile explosion.
desc.zh: 提升充能发射物爆炸的伤害半径。

desc.en: You need to be a physicist to understand how it works but this little wonder increases the velocity of the EPC's normal projectile.
desc.zh: 具体的机制少说也得有物理学位才能理解，但用矮人听得懂的话来讲：这个小玩意会提升蓄能手枪普通发射物的速度。

desc.en: Each charged shot uses less energy.
desc.zh: 每发充能射击消耗更少能量。

desc.en: Prepare a charged shot much faster.
desc.zh: 充能射击更快准备好。

desc.en: Increases the rate at which the weapon sheds heat, letting you shoot more rounds before overheating and also recovering faster from an overheat.
desc.zh: 提升武器散热效率，让你在过热前能多射几枪，也能让武器从过热中更快恢复。

desc.en: Reduces how fast the weapon overheats when holding a charged shot.
desc.zh: 降低维持充能时武器过热的速度。

desc.en: A modified containment field causes regular and charged shots to heat up the target proportionally to the amount of damage dealt. The modification also makes the charged projectile pass through all enemies dealing damage while it flies but it no longer explodes on impact.
desc.zh: 改造后的收容力场能使普通射击和充能射击对目标施加与伤害量成正比的热量。这项改造还可以让充能发射物穿透路径上的所有敌人并造成伤害，但代价是发射物受到冲击时不会发生爆炸。

desc.en: A simple modification to the containment field causes it to rupture outward on impact damaging all things in a small radius even through heavy armor.
desc.zh: 对收容力场稍微调整过后使得等离子体在击中物体时炸裂，对小范围内的所有物体乃至重甲单位造成伤害。

desc.en: A weaker containment field produces less heat for both charged and normal shots. Be aware that any high-energy impact will destabilize the charged projectile, causing a large area implosion.
desc.zh: 较弱的收容力场能减少充能射击和普通射击所产生的热量。请注意，任何高能冲击都会引爆充能发射物，造成大范围的内爆。

desc.en: With some minor tweaks to the feeding chamber the process of reloading has become much smoother, improving reload time significantly
desc.zh: 通过对枪膛进行的一些小调整，重新装填的过程变得更加丝滑，这显著减少了重新装填所需的时间

desc.en: R&D improved the magnetic flux of your circuits to avoid energy loss, resulting in a vastly improved charge rate
desc.zh: 研发部改进了武器回路中的磁力流来避免能量损失，从而使充能速度大幅提升。

desc.en: Putting an extra coil in the barrel of your weapon makes it apply more force to projectiles, which greatly increases their damage output
desc.zh: 在武器的枪管里额外加装一组线圈以提高弹丸的出膛动能，从而显著提升弹丸的伤害。

desc.en: Rerouting the excess energy back into the magnetic flux keeps the coils charging way over their limit, increasing damage the longer you hold a full charge.
desc.zh: 通过将多余的能量重新引导回磁流来使线圈过充的方式，来使伤害随满载充能的时间而增强。

desc.en: By controlling the magnetic flow of the coil you can fire as soon as the gun charges a single bar and any point after with both damage and energy consumption scaled to amount charged.
desc.zh: 通过控制线圈的磁力流，现在武器在充能达到一格时就可以射击了，而伤害和能量消耗会随充能程度自动调整。

desc.en: Projectiles release sonic impulses as they fly, sending all creatures within the trajectory effect radius fleeing in terror.
desc.zh: 弹丸会在飞行过程中释放声波脉冲，使弹道尾迹周围的所有生物仓皇逃窜。

desc.en: Modifications to the projectile enhance the sonic shockwaves potentially stunning nearby enemies.
desc.zh: 对弹丸的改造增强了音波冲击波，使其有机会震晕附近的敌人。

desc.en: Increasing the amount of injector liquid used on launch causes projectiles to leave behind a wider damage trail
desc.zh: 增加发射时使用的注液量，让弹丸留下更宽的伤害尾迹。

desc.en: The excess energy created from the spinning coils feeds into your armor and enhances its protective capabilities
desc.zh: 将线圈转动时产生的多余能量传导至你的护甲，强化其防御能力。

desc.en: Directing the waste energy forward through some careful modifications causes a shockwave that hurts any enemies
desc.zh: 将浪费的能量引导至精心调整过的部件，使其产生能够对敌人造成伤害的冲击波。

desc.en: Increasing the amount of injector liquid used on launch causes projectiles to leave behind a wider damage trail
desc.zh: 增加发射时使用的注液量，让弹丸留下更宽的伤害尾迹。

desc.en: R&D spent hours to fitting your projectiles with titanium wiring that enables them to transfer some of the electric energy from the gun to the damage trail.
desc.zh: 研发部的小伙子们花了好几个小时为你的弹丸安装钛合金线路，使它们能将武器里的一部分电能转移到伤害尾迹上。

desc.en: Killing a burning enemy turns them into a large explosion of fire and gore, burning anything nearby. The special compound also improves direct damage against burning targets.
desc.zh: 杀死燃烧中的敌人会使其炸成绚烂的火球，燃烧其周围的敌人。这种特殊化合物也提升了对燃烧中敌人的伤害。

desc.en: Careful tuning results in a trail that is able to sustain itself for a longer period of time.
desc.zh: 精密的共振调整使得尾迹能够维持更长时间。

desc.en: Directing the waste energy forward through some careful modifications causes a shockwave that hurts any enemies
desc.zh: 将浪费的能量引导至精心调整过的部件，使其产生能够对敌人造成伤害的冲击波。

desc.en: More pellets in each shell
desc.zh: 增加每发霰弹内的弹丸量。

desc.en: Decreased shot spread
desc.zh: 缩小弹丸散布。

desc.en: Fully automatic with an increased rate of fire
desc.zh: 射击模式变为全自动，同时射速提升。

desc.en: Shoot your turrets to make them create an overloaded shot
desc.zh: 射击你的炮台将使其进行过载射击。

desc.en: A bolt filled with a volatile chemical that is injected into the target's bloodstream damaging them over time. More importantly, killing the target while it is affected causes it to violently explode, damaging all creatures in the area.
desc.zh: 一款装有烈性化学物质的箭头。能在击中虫子时将药品射入目标血管内，并造成持续性伤害。更重要的是，在击杀受影响的目标时，能使其剧烈爆炸，对在区域内的所有目标造成伤害。

desc.en: A bolt filled with a mixture of pheromones which releases in contact with targets, making its allies turn against it and increases the chance of a fight breaking out.
desc.zh: 一款装有小型信息素混合物罐的弩箭，在击中目标时会释放罐子内的信息素，使目标的友军开始攻击它并增加突发混战的几率。

desc.en: A bolt fitted with small generators that electrify targets and are able to connect to other nearby Taser Bolts through an electric arc. The electric surge renders the bolt unretrievable after use.
desc.zh: 一种装有小型发电机的弩箭，可使目标触电，并且可与附近其他电击箭产生电弧。但弩箭产生的电涌会导致弩箭在发射后无法回收。

desc.en: It's a bit on the heavier side, but your total special bolt capacity is increased.
desc.zh: 多少有点重，但你同时可以携带的特殊弩箭变多了。

desc.en: More mass, greater impact and able to dig just a tad deeper into enemies, increasing the overall damage.
desc.zh: 质量更大、冲击力更强，也就扎得更深。提升整体伤害。

desc.en: It took a bit of rearranging, but you can now carry more bolts.
desc.zh: 稍微整理箭袋之后，可以携带更多弩箭了。

desc.en: R&D has fitted you with an arm brace that stabilizes your arm, which enables flawless motion allowing you to reload and switch ammo types faster, without risk of injuries.
desc.zh: 研发部为你配备了一个臂架，可以使你的手臂保持稳定，以便用完美的动作快速装填或更换弩箭，并且不用担心受伤。

desc.en: A reinforced synthetic fiber string that increases the velocity of your bolts, making them travel faster and further.
desc.zh: 一根由强力合成纤维制成的加强弓弦，可以提高箭矢飞行速度，使它飞得更快更远。

desc.en: A bolt filled with sulfuric acid that is injected into the target bloodstream on impact and creates a violent chemical reaction in contact with the benzoquinone compound of dying enemies.
desc.zh: 一款装载了硫酸的弩箭，在击中目标时硫酸会被释放入血，并且在与垂死敌人体内的苯醌化合物接触时产生剧烈的化学反应。

desc.en: Move faster for a short time after killing an enemy.
desc.zh: 击杀敌人后获得短暂移速加成。

desc.en: All bolts and your crossbow are fitted with a small radio transmitter that allows calling back retrievable bolts from a distance by hovering your crosshair over them.
desc.zh: 你的十字弩和所有弩箭都装备了一个小型无线电发射器，允许你通过将准星悬停至弩箭处远程收回弩箭。

desc.en: R&D has fitted you with an arm brace that stabilizes your arm, which enables flawless motion allowing you to reload and switch ammo types faster, without risk of injuries.
desc.zh: 研发部为你配备了一个臂架，可以使你的手臂保持稳定，以便用完美的动作快速装填或更换弩箭，并且不用担心受伤。

desc.en: Tiny devices are attached to your bolts that emit a fear inducing high pitched noise for a limited time. Can be reset and reused if picked up.
desc.zh: 装载在弩箭上的小装置，可以在一定时间内持续发出引起敌人恐惧的尖锐声音，且装置可在捡起后重置并重复利用。

desc.en: Bolt shafts made of a magnetic material that is attracted by electricity, pulling them towards electrified enemies or enemies affected by an electric field. The magnetic pull causes them to deal more damage on impact.
desc.zh: 弩箭的杆身由可被电流吸引的磁性材料制成，这使得弩箭可被触电或身处电场中的敌人所吸引，所产生的磁性拉力将会对敌人造成更高伤害。

desc.en: A more potent version of your special bolt that increases its duration.
desc.zh: 更强效的特殊弩箭延长了其效果的持续时间。

desc.en: Bolt shafts are made of a magnetic material that is attracted by electricity, making them pull towards electrified enemies or enemies affected by an electric field.
desc.zh: 弩箭的杆身由可被电流吸引的磁性材料制成，这使得弩箭可被触电或身处电场中的敌人所吸引，所产生的磁性拉力将会对敌人造成更高伤害。

desc.en: A dart filled with a mixture of pheromones which releases in contact with targets and makes allies turn against it. Although low on damage its size allows more to be carried at once.
desc.zh: 一种装有小型信息素混合物罐的弩箭，在击中目标时会释放罐子内的信息素，使目标的友军开始攻击它。 虽然伤害很低，但它的大小允许你一次带上一大包。

desc.en: A bolt fitted with small generators that electrify targets and are able to connect to other nearby Taser Bolts through an electric arc
desc.zh: 一种装有小型发电机的弩箭，它可以让目标触电，并且可与附近其他电击箭产生电弧。

desc.en: Shoot longer before needing to repressurize.
desc.zh: 在重新加压前能喷射更长时间。

desc.en: Freeze things at a faster rate.
desc.zh: 加快冻结速度。

desc.en: Improves the heat capacity of the stream so you can freeze things at a faster rate.
desc.zh: 提升冰流的热容量以更快冻住目标。

desc.en: Promotes ice-crystal formation in the stream resulting in more direct damage.
desc.zh: 促进射流中的冰晶形成，提升直接伤害。

desc.en: Start freezing things as soon as you pull the trigger with a near-instant turbine response.
desc.zh: 瞬时响应的涡轮系统，让你在扣下扳机的瞬间就开始向周围的敌人散播低温。

desc.en: Freeze things at a faster rate.
desc.zh: 加快冻结速度。

desc.en: Lets you shoot for a longer time before needing to refill the pressure chamber.
desc.zh: 在压力仓需要重新加压前能喷射更长时间。

desc.en: If you completely empty the pressure chamber, the weapon will immediately start repressurizing, safety be damned!
desc.zh: 当压力仓被完全清空后，武器会立刻开始重新加压。虫群冻开花，安全去他妈！

desc.en: Increases the effective range of the weapon.
desc.zh: 提升武器的有效射程。

desc.en: Refill the pressure chamber faster.
desc.zh: 更快地重新填充压力仓。

desc.en: Improves the heat capacity of the stream so you can freeze things at a faster rate.
desc.zh: 提升冰流的热容量以更快冻住目标。

desc.en: Promotes ice-crystal formation in the stream resulting in more direct damage.
desc.zh: 促进射流中的冰晶形成，提升直接伤害。

desc.en: Any enemy that strays close to you while firing the Cryo Cannon will start to freeze.

desc.en: Shoot at own risk
desc.zh: 朝它开枪风险自负

desc.zh: 对触电状态下的敌人造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Temporary movement speed bonus after emptying clip
desc.zh: 射空弹匣后获得短暂移速加成。

desc.en: Increases the range of the flame for long distance incineration.
desc.zh: 提升火焰射程，以便从更远距离点燃敌人。

desc.en: Burn everything around you
desc.zh: 点燃自身周围的所有事物。

desc.en: Sticky flames duration increase
desc.zh: 提升火墙持续时间。

desc.en: Increased fuel consumption rate for more damage
desc.zh: 提升燃油流通速率来产出更多伤害。

desc.zh: 穿过火墙的生物会受到减速。

desc.en: A chance that your target will flee in terror for every second that it is in your flame.
desc.zh: 敌人有几率在你火焰持续的燃烧下恐惧地逃开。

desc.en: Sticky flames duration increase
desc.zh: 提升火墙持续时间。

desc.zh: 受到直接伤害致死的敌人有几率爆炸。

desc.zh: 更厚实的燃芯可以维持燃烧更长时间。

desc.zh: 提升冷却速率。

desc.en: Increased rate of fire and faster gyro stabilization
desc.zh: 提高射速，变相加快陀螺仪稳定速度。

desc.en: Improved armor breaking
desc.zh: 提升护甲破坏效果。

desc.en: Shaped bullets capable of passing through a target!
desc.zh: 能够穿透目标的异形弹头！

desc.en: Barrels keep spinning for a longer time after firing, keeping the gun stable for longer
desc.zh: 转管在停止射击后会继续转更长时间，使武器更长时间地保持稳定。

desc.en: Barrels keep spinning for a longer time after firing, keeping the gun stable for longer
desc.zh: 转管在停止射击后将维持旋转更长时间，使武器更长时间地保持在稳定状态。

desc.en: Increased Accuracy
desc.zh: 提高精准度。

desc.en: Start killing things sooner with a shorter spinup time
desc.zh: 更短的起转时间让你能更快开始杀敌。

desc.en: Damage increase when fully stabilized
desc.zh: 提升转管满转稳定后的伤害。

desc.en: Every kill cools the gun
desc.zh: 每次击杀都会冷却机枪。

desc.en: Rounds fired when the heat meter is red will burn the target
desc.zh: 热量指示器达到红色时，射出的子弹会灼烧目标。

desc.en: R&D mixed the goo with a nasty secret ingredient that melts away the plating of goo covered enemies in record time!
desc.zh: 研发部在蚀泥中添加了一种危险的机密原料，使得被蚀泥覆盖的敌人的护甲会在创纪录的时间内被融化！

desc.en: When the goo is exposed to air it expands, making puddles cover a larger area on impact.
desc.zh: 蚀泥在接触到空气后膨胀，在受到冲击后可以形成更大的蚀泥坑。

desc.en: The air pressurizer is improved, making the projectiles travel faster and further.
desc.zh: 更好的气体压缩器使发射物可以飞得更快更远。

desc.en: With the Dyse Nozzle your charged shot is launched with more force, making it more damaging on impact.
desc.zh: 高压喷嘴使你的充能射击在发射时力量更强，以此在撞击时造成更大伤害。

desc.en: With the Atomizer Nozzle your charged shot will leave behind more fragments on impact.
desc.zh: 装上雾化喷嘴后，充能射击的发射物能够产生更多蚀泥块。

desc.en: Normal shots do more damage on impact.
desc.zh: 普通射击在撞击时造成更大伤害。

desc.en: The goo goes through a process of supersaturation after impact, making the effects and puddles last longer.
desc.zh: 蚀泥受到冲击后将经历过度饱和过程，使蚀泥坑与腐蚀效果的维持时间变得更长。

desc.en: With the Spillback Extension added to the nozzle you spend less goo when charging.
desc.zh: 在喷嘴上安装回流配件可以减少充能射击的蚀泥消耗。

desc.en: The spooling mechanism has been improved and can get you to a full charge faster!
desc.zh: 改良的搅拌装置使你的充能更加迅速！

desc.en: A new and improved goo recipe with very aggressive properties makes every second in it more hellish!
desc.zh: 全新改良的蚀泥配方，具有超强酸性，在这种蚀泥里的每一秒都更加痛苦。

desc.en: Disrupting the protein molecules in the goo mix has made it more rigid and harder for creatures to move through greatly increasing enemy slowdown from both direct hits and puddles.
desc.zh: 破坏蚀泥混合物中的蛋白质分子使其更加粘稠，使生物更难在里面移动。大幅增强直击和蚀泥坑的减速效果。

desc.en: Spend less time waiting and more time swinging
desc.zh: 更少等待，更多爽快。

desc.en: Increased range
desc.zh: 提升抓钩射程。

desc.en: Increased range
desc.zh: 提升射程

desc.en: Faster cooldown and a voided warranty
desc.zh: 使冷却速度更快，但是无法保修。

desc.en: Faster hook retraction means a faster dwarf. Survival not guaranteed.
desc.zh: 钩子收的快，人就飞的快。当然，安全系数有待商榷。

desc.en: Hook shoots out at a higher speed
desc.zh: 抓钩将以更快的速度飞出。

desc.en: Temporary fall damage reduction bonus after releasing the Grappling Gun
desc.zh: 松开抓钩后将短暂获得坠落伤害减免。

desc.en: Burst of Speed! Using the Grappling Gun gives you a Temporary Movement Speed Bonus when you land.
desc.zh: 蓄势待发！使用抓钩枪后着陆将获得短暂移速加成。

desc.en: Damage radius increase.
desc.zh: 提升伤害半径。

desc.en: 50% damage converted to heat. This will reduce direct damage, but will set enemies on fire.
desc.zh: 将 50% 的伤害转换为热量。这将减少直接伤害，但会使敌人着火。

desc.en: More damage on average but it's a bit inconsistent with a spread of 80% to 140%
desc.zh: 平均伤害提升，但单发伤害会在 80% 至 140% 区间浮动。

desc.en: Stuns creatures within the blast radius
desc.zh: 击晕爆炸范围内的生物。

desc.en: Deals damage on direct impact
desc.zh: 榴弹直接命中敌人将对其造成伤害。

desc.en: Launched grenades will only detonate when they are in close proximity to an enemy or after the projectile comes to a complete stop. Explosion range is also increased. Note: The trigger takes a moment to arm, indicated by a green light, and until then the grenade functions as usual.
desc.zh: 发射出去的榴弹只有在足够靠近敌人或完全静止的时候才会引爆。爆炸范围也略微增加。注：感应触发存在启动时间，启动后榴弹将闪烁绿光。感应启动前榴弹性质与普通榴弹无异。

desc.en: Launched grenades will only detonate when they are in close proximity to an enemy or after the projectile comes to a complete stop. Note: The trigger takes a moment to arm, indicated by a green light, and until then the grenade functions as usual.
desc.zh: 发射出去的榴弹只有在足够靠近敌人或完全静止的时候才会引爆。注：感应触发存在启动时间，启动后榴弹将闪烁绿光。感应启动前榴弹性质与普通榴弹无异。

desc.en: By inducing a stronger gas flow through the beam particles the damage area around the impact zone is increased.
desc.zh: 通过将更强的气流引入光束粒子中，冲击区的杀伤范围提高了。

desc.en: The energy density of the beam is increased, improving direct damage.
desc.zh: 通过提升光束的能量密度，你武器的直接伤害提高了。

desc.en: R&D custom fitted you with a larger battery, increasing the max capacity.
desc.zh: 研发部为你的武器安装了一个更大的电池，从而提高最大备弹量。

desc.en: Opening the structure of the battery with a new experimental material enables much faster charging!
desc.zh: 利用新型实验材料使电池与武器结构间透空，便于其更快充能。

desc.en: Placing a simple ball of aluminum foil between the battery and main capacitor was enough to transfer a lot more juice with each charge! Who even needs R&D anymore?
desc.zh: 想要每次充能传输更多的能量，只需在电池与主电容之间塞一个平平无奇的铝箔球！谁还用得着研发部啊？

desc.en: Releasing a screw from the stability safety mechanism causes the beam to more forcefully rupture outward on impact, increasing area damage.
desc.zh: 从安全稳定装置上拆下个螺丝，使得光束在撞击平面时产生更强的溅射，从而增加范围伤害。

desc.en: Rerouting nitrogen gas through the beam increases its pressure power density and enables it to melt armor plating.
desc.zh: 将氮气重新导入射线，让射线的高压功率密度显著提高，使其可以融化护甲。

desc.en: A tweaked beam oscillator increases the intensity of the thermal shockwaves on direct impact, transferring more heat to the target.
desc.zh: 调整后的光束振荡器提升了直接命中时的热能冲击波强度，将热量更多地传递给目标。

desc.en: By adding hydrogen to the gas mixture the beam molecules will be pushed apart on impact with electrocuted enemies, increasing damage dealt.
desc.zh: 通过在混合气体中添加氢气，使光束分子会在命中触电的敌人时产生分离，从而增加造成的伤害。

desc.en: An invention with the purpose of making war more energy-efficient has been added as a fancy attachment, enabling your weapon to extend the current beam duration with every kill.
desc.zh: 一款为了提高作战时的能量效率为目的制作的精良配件，可使武器在每次击杀时为电容注入稍许能量，延长开火时间。

desc.en: A special dazzler lens is attached to the weapon, making the beam emit a strong infrared light on impact, slowing down enemies in the area of effect.
desc.zh: 通过在武器上安装一个特制的眩目透镜，使光束在命中处散发出强烈的红外光，从而减速影响范围内的敌人。

desc.en: Cut off the beam at any time by releasing the fire button.
desc.zh: 松开扳机以随时切断光束

desc.en: Reload time -0.5 seconds
desc.zh: 换弹时间 -0.5 秒

desc.en: Improves armor breaking capabilities
desc.zh: 提升等离子线的护甲破坏能力

desc.en: Longer plasma line
desc.zh: 更长的等离子线

desc.en: Staggers creatures within the blast radius
desc.zh: 对 爆炸范围内的生物造成硬直

desc.en: The line projectile opens almost immediately and can hit multiple targets at very close range.
desc.zh: 等离子线几乎瞬间展开，以便在极近距离就可命中多名敌人。

desc.en: The line projectile opens almost immediately and can hit multiple targets at very close range.
desc.zh: 等离子线几乎瞬间展开，使其在极近距离就可命中多名敌人。

desc.en: The projectile is able to travel for a longer period of time before collapsing
desc.zh: 等离子线在坍缩前能飞行更长时间。

desc.en: Get a significantly wider plasma line that can hit more targets at once.
desc.zh: 使等离子线显著加长，能一次命中更多目标。

desc.en: The line projectile opens almost immediately and can hit multiple targets at very close range.
desc.zh: 等离子线几乎瞬间展开，以便在极近距离就可命中多名敌人。

desc.en: A heavily preloaded spring combined with a smaller latch shorten the time it takes to reload.
desc.zh: 极度预载的弹簧配上更小的弹匣扣，缩短了换弹所需的时间。

desc.en: Greatly improves the armor breaking capabilities of the plasma beam.
desc.zh: 大幅提升等离子线的护甲破坏能力。

desc.en: The plasma beam is split into 3 lines that cover a taller area making it possible to hit multiple targets at various heights.
desc.zh: 等离子线将上下分裂成 3 束，提升纵向覆盖面积，以便攻击到同一方向但位处不同高度的敌人。

desc.en: The projectile explodes at the end of its lifecycle when the nodes collapse damaging anything unlucky enough to be nearby and leaving a residual plasma field for a short time. You can also manually trigger the explosion by pulling the trigger a second time while the projectile is in flight.
desc.zh: 等离子体在寿命结束时，两端节点将会坍缩在一起产生爆炸，对不幸在其附近的任何东西造成伤害，并在短时间内留下一片等离子场。你也可以在射线飞行途中再次按下扳机来手动触发爆炸。

desc.en: The beam leaves behind a residual trail of plasma that will continuously damage any enemy that gets too close.
desc.zh: 射线经过的地方会有等离子尾迹残留，能持续伤害靠近的敌人。

desc.en: The plasma beam will stun most of the denizens of Hoxxes on contact.
desc.zh: 等离子线能够击晕绝大部分的霍克斯星原生生物。

desc.en: The Zoom Lens increases the range of your camera, enabling you to lock on to targets farther away.
desc.zh: 变焦镜头提升了镜头的采样距离，使你可以在更远处锁定敌人。

desc.en: Loosening a screw in the lock on mechanism bypasses the safety at a full lock on, making your rounds do more damage.
desc.zh: 在锁定机制中做点手脚来绕过满锁定保险机制，让你的子弹能造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Changes size of projectiles
desc.zh: 改变发射物大小

desc.en: The Macro Lens decreases the size of the lock on area for extra tight control and focused targeting.
desc.zh: 微距镜头牺牲锁定区域的大小，以换取更易的操控性与单体锁定。

desc.en: The Macro Lens decreases the size of the lock on area for extra tight control and focused targeting while also greatly extending the lock on range.
desc.zh: 微距镜头牺牲锁定区域的大小，以换取更易的操控性与单体锁定，同时也大幅增加了锁定距离。

desc.en: The Zoom Lens increases the range of your camera, enabling you to lock on to targets farther away.
desc.zh: 变焦镜头提升了镜头的采样距离，使你可以在更远处锁定敌人。

desc.en: The CCD Array Add-on enables the camera to keep track of enemies in a wider angle and also expands the angle at which new locks can be acquired.
desc.zh: 新增的感光耦合元件提升了武器在失去锁定前可旋转的最大角度，同时允许武器锁定更广角度内的敌人。

desc.en: A simple copper wire and some reactive chemicals makes your rounds pack an extra punch in contact with electricity and high temperatures.
desc.zh: 一根简单的铜线和一些活性化学品能让你的子弹对触电和燃烧的敌人造成更高伤害。

desc.en: This premium software update makes your camera prioritize targets with lower health and avoids placing more locks than necessary. Now that's SmЯt™!
desc.zh: 该款付费软件升级能让镜头优先锁定生命值更低的目标，同时避免锁定层数超过击杀所需层数。真是个“大聪明™”！

desc.en: The shutter speed sensor reduces the time between lock ons, helping you reach a full lock on faster.
desc.zh: 高速快门传感器降低了每次锁定之间的延迟，帮助你更快达成满锁定层数。

desc.en: The aperture extension helps the camera sort out more light and minimizes distortion, increasing the amount of lock ons you can place on targets.
desc.zh: 光圈配件可帮助相机滤出更多光线并减少画面畸变，从而增加你每次可锁定的最大层数。

desc.en: An electrical generator has been wired into the lock on mechanism, turning rounds electrical when a lock on threshold is passed.
desc.zh: 在锁定装置上加装一个起电装置，当单体目标的锁定层数超过一定阈值时可为子弹附加电击效果。

desc.en: Denting a cavity in the bullets cause them to emit a fear inducing sound when fired en masse affecting all enemies around the shooter. Both the strength of the effect and its range are affected by how many rounds are fired in the burst.
desc.zh: 在子弹上凿个槽，就能使武器在连射时发出尖锐声响，令周围的敌人陷入恐慌。连射的子弹越多，恐惧的触发几率与作用范围就越大。

desc.en: R&D improved the fuel consumption rate of your missiles, leaving more fuel on impact and causing a bigger explosion.
desc.zh: 研发部的小伙子们改进了你的飞弹的燃料消耗率，现在飞弹命中目标时能残留更多的燃料，并从而产生更大的爆炸。

desc.en: With gas cylinders filled to the brim your missiles really pack a punch!
desc.zh: 让你的飞弹在被压得不能再满的气缸的助推下创得更狠！

desc.en: Extra missiles stored in fancy belts. One for each shoulder!
desc.zh: 整整齐齐排满额外飞弹的花哨弹带，每个肩膀都能挂一条！

desc.en: These anti-tank missiles will crack those big bugs' plating like an egg!
desc.zh: 这些反坦克飞弹射穿大号虫子的外骨骼简直易如反坦！

desc.en: The engines in your missiles have been replaced with more powerful variants, increasing their max velocity and turn rate.
desc.zh: 将飞弹里的推进器更换为更强力的型号，提升最高速度和转向速度。

desc.en: R&D improved the feed mechanism of this bad boy, making it fire faster!
desc.zh: 研发部改进了这把猛兽的供弹结构，提高了它的射速！

desc.en: Half the size, but just as lethal. Your magazines can store a lot more missiles now.
desc.zh: 尺寸减半，但依然致命。你的弹匣现在可以储存更多的飞弹。

desc.en: With this high energy fuel the impact force of your missiles hit like a truck.
desc.zh: 这些高能燃料能给你的飞弹赋予泥头车般的冲击力。

desc.en: R&D packed a little surprise in the missile heads that will tear those creatures' fleshy bits to shreds.
desc.zh: 研发部在飞弹的弹头里装了一点小惊喜，足以把那些虫子撕成渣渣。

desc.en: With a pinch of nitroglycerin added to the fuel your missiles become ticking time-bombs, doing increased damage the longer they stay in the air.
desc.zh: 在飞弹里面加点硝化甘油能让它变成一个定时炸弹。在空中飞行的时间越长，能造成的伤害就越多。

desc.en: 33% damage converted to heat. This will reduce direct damage, but can set enemies on fire.
desc.zh: 将 33% 的伤害转换为热量。这将会减少直接伤害，但可以点燃敌人。

desc.en: R&D furiously hit each missile with a wrench to give the impact shockwaves some extra oomph.
desc.zh: 研发部的人员们猛地给了每发飞弹一扳手，让它们的爆炸波更有精神了。

desc.en: A convex lens that focuses the microwaves and increases their damage output
desc.zh: 一面可将微波向内聚焦以增加伤害的凸透镜。

desc.en: Adding a powerful magnetron tube and a new capacitor increases the total ammo
desc.zh: 加装一个强力磁控管与一个全新的电容以提升总载弹量。

desc.en: A concave lens that curves the microwaves outward and increases their impact radius
desc.zh: 一面可将微波向外折射以增加伤害半径的凹透镜。

desc.en: Jamming a heat pipe into the magnetron seemed unsafe and irresponsible initially, but it really helped reduce heat build up!
desc.zh: 往磁控管里塞一根导热管看似既不靠谱又不安全，但它确实对减少热量累积有所帮助！

desc.en: By simply exchanging your power supply for a bigger model your rate of fire is increased
desc.zh: 通过简单地换装一个更大号的供电装置，武器的射速得到了提升。

desc.en: R&D fitted your weapon with a thermoelectric cooler, increasing its ability to cool down faster
desc.zh: 研发部为你的武器加装了热电制冷器，以提高其冷却速度。

desc.en: Tweaking the transmitter wavelength causes microwaves to densify organic matter temporarily, making it harder for targets to move
desc.zh: 对发射器的波长进行调整后会使微波暂时提升有机物的密度，使目标难以行动。

desc.en: A new hybrid circuit makes microwaves compensate for sudden changes in temperature, causing them to heat or cool burning or frozen targets further and radiate some of their temperature to surrounding enemies
desc.zh: 一种能够使微波对及时的温度变化作出调整的新型混合电路，从而进一步提升着火目标或降低被冻结目标的温度，并将部分的温度传递至附近的敌人身上。

desc.en: Push reload to put the power supply into overdrive, significantly increasing rate of fire. To compensate for the power flow the waves are focused inward at the cost of AoE radius. Push reload to deactivate it.
desc.zh: 按下换弹键使供电装置进入过载状态，进而显著提升射速。 作为能源流动的补偿措施，微波将会向内聚集并缩小作用范围。再次按下换弹键来解除使用。

desc.en: Push reload to activate the Wide Lens Add-on which curves the microwaves further, but the power required to use it takes a toll on the cooler, increasing heat per shot. Push reload to deactivate it.
desc.zh: 按下换弹键以激活广角镜附件，进一步扩大微波作用范围，但是所需的能量将会对散热器产生影响，从而增加每次射击所产生的热量。再次按下换弹键来解除使用。

desc.en: A transmitter that enables rays to destroy poisoned and corroded cells in hit targets, increasing damage output with a chance to spread a poisonous vapor to nearby enemies.
desc.zh: 一种可使射线摧毁目标身上中毒或坏死细胞的传输器，在提升伤害的同时将有几率制造出会传播至附近目标的毒雾。

desc.en: Exposure to the microwaves cause the liquids within biological targets to expand, giving them a chance to explode.
desc.zh: 暴露于微波下会使生物目标的体液急剧膨胀，使得它们有几率爆炸。

desc.en: R&D has plugged in a temperature scrambler that makes the microwaves cause quick shifts in temperatures of burning or freezing targets with a chance of triggering a temperature shock that spreads a mist of extreme heat or cold.
desc.zh: 研发部在武器内部加装了一个温度扰频器，使微波可以快速改变燃烧或冻结着的目标的温度，并有几率触发散播高温或极寒雾气的温度骤变。

desc.en: Bonus damage against Mactera aliens
desc.zh: 对异虫蝇能够造成额外伤害

desc.en: Bonus corrosive damage
desc.zh: 可造成额外的腐蚀伤害。

desc.en: Expertly adjusted for pin-point accuracy on the first shot and a reduced maximum spread.
desc.zh: 将准线严格校准后，武器的最大扩散降低，且最小扩散变为绝对精准。

desc.en: A custom firing mechanism lets you fire two shots so fast that the recoil does not get to affect the accuracy of the second shot, though the base accuracy of the weapon still affects shot spread. The quick consecutive hits are also great at breaking armor. To prevent the gun from exploding in your hand there is a delay before you can fire the next burst.
desc.zh: 特制的扳机组允许你快速射出两发子弹，速度快到第一发的后坐根本影响不到第二发的精度，当然武器本身的扩散另当别论。快速且紧密的射击也尤其适合用于破甲。但为了防止武器在你手中炸膛，每轮点射之间必须进行等待。

desc.en: This little tweak reduces weapon recoil and spread per shot helping you hit consecutive shots.
desc.zh: 这个小配件能抑制武器后坐力以及每次射击时增加的散射，有助于连续且稳定地命中目标。

name.zh: 神经性腐蚀毒素催化剂

desc.en: Causes a target affected by neurotoxins or corrosive sludge to temporarily take more damage over time. Any biological target that dies while affected will violently explode damaging everything in the vicinity. Multiple rounds increase the potency of the reaction and the size and power of the death explosion.
desc.zh: 暂时性提升目标所受到的来自神经毒素或腐蚀性淤泥效果的持续伤害。在效果内死亡的生物目标将产生猛烈的爆炸，毁坏周围的一切事物。多次命中会增强该反应的效果，致使目标受到更多持续伤害并强化死亡时的爆炸范围及伤害。

desc.en: Bonus fire damage to burning targets.
desc.zh: 对点燃目标造成额外火焰伤害。

desc.en: Less heat generated per shot.
desc.zh: 每次射击产生更少热量。

desc.en: Launches the plasma projectiles at a higher velocity.
desc.zh: 提高等离子发射物的飞行速度。

desc.en: Hand-aligned coils with a custom two phase acceleration profile improves accuracy and reduces spread.
desc.zh: 手工校准的二段加速型线圈增加了精准度并减小了散布。

desc.en: The new and improved passive cooling system sheds heat faster when not firing.
desc.zh: 新改良的被动散热系统能在非射击状态下更快散热。

desc.en: Pressing the reload button will force the DRAK-25 into overheat mode letting you quickly cool the weapon.
desc.zh: 按下换弹键会强制使 DRAK-25 进入过热模式，让武器更快冷却。

desc.en: Pumping excess heat back into the system results in a faster rate of fire when the weapon passes 50% heat.
desc.zh: 通过将过剩的热能导回至系统中，使武器在超过 50% 过热时的射速提高。

desc.en: The projectiles carry excess charge distributed across the containment field giving a small chance to electrocute the target on impact.
desc.zh: 等离子体能在收容力场里携带更多电荷，在击中时有几率能电击敌人。

desc.en: A simple modification to the containment field causes it to rupture outward on impact damaging all things in a small radius even through heavy armor.
desc.zh: 对收容力场稍微调整过后使得等离子体在击中物体时炸裂，对小范围内的所有物体乃至重甲单位造成伤害。

desc.en: The burning hot gases motivate you to move significantly faster after the weapon has overheated.
desc.zh: 烫人的气体促使你在武器过热之后跑得更快。

desc.en: Carries more platforms
desc.zh: 携带更多平台

desc.en: Carries even more platforms
desc.zh: 携带甚至更多平台

desc.en: Shock-absorbing compound reduces fall damage
desc.zh: 改用可以吸收冲击的复合材料，可减少坠落伤害。

desc.en: Enemies will avoid walking on the Plastcrete Foam whenever possible.
desc.zh: 敌人会尽量避免在注胶混凝土上行走。

desc.en: Bullet detonates creating a radius of damage
desc.zh: 子弹爆炸造成范围伤害

desc.en: Bonus damage against Glyphids
desc.zh: 对异虫造成额外伤害

desc.en: No aim penalty while moving
desc.zh: 移动时不产生精准度削减。

desc.en: Improved Accuracy
desc.zh: 提升精准度

desc.en: Bullet detonates creating a radius of damage but deals less direct damage.
desc.zh: 子弹将在命中时爆炸，造成范围伤害，但造成的直接伤害更少。

desc.en: No aim penalty while moving
desc.zh: 移动时不产生精准度削减。

desc.en: Chance to poison your target. Affected creatures move slower and take damage over time.
desc.zh: 有几率使你的目标中毒。受影响的生物移动更慢且受到持续伤害。

desc.en: More electric damage
desc.zh: 更多电击伤害

desc.en: Better chance to electrocute target
desc.zh: 有更大几率使目标触电。

desc.en: More damage to targets that are in an electric field
desc.zh: 对触电状态下的敌人造成更多伤害。

desc.en: Greatly increased magazine capacity
desc.zh: 大幅增加弹匣容量。

desc.en: Chance for electrocution to arc from one target to others
desc.zh: 有几率产生电弧使目标附近的单位触电。

desc.en: Shockwave from the blast deals extra damage to any enemies unlucky enough to be in the area extending 4m infront of you.
desc.zh: 开枪产生的冲击波会对不幸在你面前 4 米范围内的敌人造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Tweaked trigger mechanism allows you to unload both barrels in quick succession dealing massive damage to anything infront of you.
desc.zh: 调整后的扳机能让你一次性快速发射双管弹药，对你面前的任何东西造成大量伤害。

desc.en: The shockwave from the blast deals extra damage to any enemies unlucky enough to be in the area extending 4m in front of you.
desc.zh: 开枪产生的冲击波会对不幸在你面前 4 米范围内的敌人造成额外伤害。

desc.en: Reloads automatically when unequipped for longer than 5 seconds
desc.zh: 武器将在闲置 5 秒后自动换弹。

desc.en: Convert some of the damage to Fire damage
desc.zh: 将部分伤害转换为热量。

desc.en: Chance to scare nearby creatures whenever you shoot
desc.zh: 射击时有几率吓退附近生物。

desc.en: Builds faster
desc.zh: 更快搭建

desc.en: Builds faster
desc.zh: 更快搭建

desc.en: The sentry can fire more shots before refilling.
desc.zh: 能向哨戒炮装填更多弹药。

desc.en: You can carry more ammo for the Sentry Guns
desc.zh: 你可以携带更多哨戒炮弹药

desc.en: Paint a target with your laser pointer and the LMG will take care of the rest.
desc.zh: 用你的激光指示器标记一个目标，哨戒炮就会负责剩下的工作。

desc.en: Can deploy two separate sentries at once.
desc.zh: 可同时部署两台哨戒炮。

desc.en: Can deploy two separate sentries at once. Comes with extra ammo to feed the hungry killing machines.
desc.zh: 可同时部署两台独立的哨戒炮。附带喂给这些饥饿杀戮机器的额外弹药。

desc.en: An upgraded model with more punch, longer range and greater ammo capacity.
desc.zh: 伤害更大、射程更远、载弹更多的改良型哨戒炮。

desc.en: Takes less time to build a sentry.
desc.zh: 搭建哨戒炮的耗时更少。

desc.en: Refill a turret's ammo faster.
desc.zh: 更快装填哨戒炮的弹药。

desc.en: The sentry can fire more shots before refilling.
desc.zh: 能向哨戒炮装填更多弹药。

desc.en: A design variation with greatly increased shot power and a focused scan angle.
desc.zh: 一种能在大幅提升伤害的同时，抑制哨戒炮扫描角度的变体设计。

desc.en: Upgraded sensors increase the effective range and target acquisition speed of the LMG and are synchronised with your laser pointer, prioritizing the target you highlight.
desc.zh: 升级后的感应器提升了哨戒炮的有效射程和锁定速度，并与你的激光指示器相同步，优先攻击你标记的目标。

desc.en: Generator recharges faster
desc.zh: 护盾发生器能更快完成充能。

desc.en: Shield protects a larger area
desc.zh: 护盾能保护更大范围。

desc.en: Shield lasts longer
desc.zh: 护盾持续更长时间。

desc.en: Generator recharges faster
desc.zh: 护盾发生器能更快完成充能。

desc.en: Shield lasts longer
desc.zh: 护盾持续更长时间。

desc.en: The shield's protective properties linger for a few seconds after you leave the shield.
desc.zh: 护盾的减伤效果能在你走出保护范围后仍维持数秒。

desc.en: Shield protects a larger area
desc.zh: 护盾能保护更大范围。

desc.en: 1 Extra zipline to deploy
desc.zh: 额外增加1条缆绳

desc.en: Increases the range of the zipline by 5 meters
desc.zh: 滑索缆绳射程增长5米。

desc.en: Zipline can span a greater distance
desc.zh: 滑索可跨越更远距离。

desc.en: Increases the operational angle of the zipline
desc.zh: 扩大滑索的最大部署角度。

desc.en: Zipline can span a greater distance
desc.zh: 滑索可跨越更远距离。

desc.en: Take less damage if you fall off the zipline
desc.zh: 减少脱离滑索所受到的坠落伤害。

desc.en: Improved acceleration and speed when riding Ziplines.
desc.zh: 提升使用滑索时的加速度和最大速度。
